newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian interest rates to climb in 1997 - SBI Capital.
newsitem.headline: Indian interest rates to climb in 1997 - SBI Capital.

text.p: Indian interest rates are expected to rise later in calendar 1997, securities firm SBI Capital Markets said in a report on Tuesday.
"With the last phase of the CRR (cash reserve ratio for banks) cut being effected, the liquidity position of banks has improved considerably," it said.
As credit offtake was not yet picking up as desired, banks may resort to further cuts in prime lending rates, it said.
"Yields and interest rates have fallen more due to the surplus liquidity (courtesy the Reserve Bank of India) and lower credit offtake (courtesy industry)," the report said.
"The surplus liquidity will not last and with inflation expected to increase in 1997, we expect interest rates to start moving northwards later during the (calendar) year."
